output_json.diff_review: Diff is minimal and scoped: one product file changed (AbstractUnArchiver.java, +35/-0) plus one new test file. No modification to the PoV files (.security-pipeline/pov/* only added, untouched/unmodified — pov.diff shows only new files, no edits to existing product code from the PoV stage). The fix is placed at the single shared sink (extractFile) that both TarUnArchiver and AbstractZipUnArchiver call, so it addresses every trace listed in the alert (tar getName() path and zip getName()/UnicodePathExtraField path) without needing per-callsite duplication. The check uses canonical paths and a strict startsWith(destPath + File.separator) test, which correctly handles ../ traversal, nested ../../, absolute paths, and backslash-based traversal after canonicalization. The patcher explicitly considered and declined to extend the check to symlink targets, documenting that doing so broke the pre-existing SymlinkTest which intentionally supports symlinks pointing outside destDirectory — that sink is not part of the reported alert traces, so leaving it out is a reasonable, justified scoping decision rather than an omission. No unrelated behavior changes, no broad refactors, no disabling of functionality.
output_json.pov_result: Reran `bash .security-pipeline/pov/run_pov.sh` independently via the docker wrapper against the patched worktree: extraction now throws ArchiverException ("Entry '../pov-escaped-marker.txt' is outside the execution destination directory..."), the escaped marker file does not exist outside dest, and the script prints "[POV] SAFE" and exits 1 — matching the orchestrator's reported pov_after_patch result and confirming the original POV no longer reproduces the vulnerability.
output_json.regression_result: Reran `mvn -B test` independently via the docker wrapper: 151 tests run, 0 failures, 0 errors, 1 skipped (pre-existing skip, unrelated), BUILD SUCCESS — matching the orchestrator's reported regression_1 result. This includes SymlinkTest (6/6 pass, confirming legitimate symlink-crossing-directory behavior is preserved) and the new PathTraversalExtractionTest (2/2 pass).
output_json.summary: The patch adds a containment check (assertWithinDestination) in AbstractUnArchiver.extractFile() immediately after FileUtils.resolveFile(dir, entryName), before any filesystem side effect (overwrite check, mkdirs, symlink/dir creation, FileOutputStream write). It canonicalizes both the destination and resolved entry path and throws ArchiverException if the entry resolves outside the destination. Since both TarUnArchiver and AbstractZipUnArchiver funnel through this single shared method, the fix covers all reported alert traces (tar and zip) with one minimal change. A regression test (PathTraversalExtractionTest) was added exercising both tar and zip malicious entries through the real public APIs.
